name: 01_master
prompt:
A museum-quality oil painting in the manner of Vincent van Gogh's 'Sunflowers' (Arles, 1888), reimagined as a wide cinematic still life with photographic depth of field.
CENTER (sharp focus): a rustic two-tone earthenware vase - lower half yellow ochre, upper half pale chrome yellow, outlined in blue-green - standing on a warm ochre table. It holds about fifteen sunflowers at every stage of life: tight green buds, flaming full blooms with spiky orange-yellow petals radiating like small suns, drooping wilted heads with curling petals, and dark bristly seed heads gone to seed; twisting green stems and a few ragged leaves.
BACKGROUND: a luminous pale lemon-yellow wall built from short hatched directional brushstrokes, with a clear horizontal line where the wall meets the table, lots of empty wall space on both sides of the vase.
COLOR: a symphony of more than thirty yellows - lemon yellow, chrome yellow, Naples yellow, yellow ochre, raw sienna, earth yellow - accented with Prussian-blue and viridian contour lines and a few touches of vermilion.
PAINT: extremely thick impasto; seed heads are crusty, rough and bristling with dabs of paint; every petal is a single loaded stroke with bristle grooves and raised ridges catching the light.
DEPTH OF FIELD: in the extreme foreground, at the very left edge, right edge and bottom edge, large out-of-focus sunflower petals, a leaf and a fallen sunflower head are softly blurred like a macro lens bokeh, framing the scene. The vase and bouquet stay crisp.
No text, no signature, no letters, no frame, no border.
